name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
measures: People employed as software developers in the US
about: The Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics program estimates US employment by occupation each year. We use code 15-1252, Software Developers. It shows how many people have these jobs, as context for postings.
attribution: Data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. BLS has not reviewed or endorsed this site or its results.
limitations: It counts people employed, not open jobs.
It is published once a year, for May.
The API only serves the latest year, so history builds up as the index keeps running.
